newsitem.title: UK: EMI stumbles ahead of Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: EMI stumbles ahead of Q3 results.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc stumbled on Monday ahead of the UK music publisher's results, dealers said.
AT 1145 GMT, the shares were down 36p to 1199, having fallen as low as 1187 earlier. But trading volume was light, with only 221,000 shares changing hands.
EMI shares have been falling for the past six months, but bounced more than 10 percent from an 18-month low earlier this month.
Worries about the health of the UK and U.S. music markets and negative comments from brokers recently have weighed on the shares.
The group is set to release its third quarter results tomorrow. Analysts surveyed by Reuters were expecting profits of between 326 million to 377 million stg. --London newsroom +44 171 542-5106
